# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Child / Pre-teen (around 6 years old when introduced, around 13-14 by Volume 5)
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke (initially moved to Avonlea after his mother's death)
- **Role:** Student

## Appearance

Davy is a fair-haired boy with bright blue eyes, curls, and a freckled face. He has a naturally mischievous and engaging smile that often softens the hearts of those around him, even when he has been up to trouble. His twin sister Dora is contrastingly quiet and neat in appearance.

## Personality

Davy is exuberant, highly inquisitive, mischievous, and delightfully frank. He constantly asks endless questions about God, nature, and social etiquette, often reaching humorous or bizarre conclusions. Though he frequently gets into trouble through his impulsive pranks and naive schemes, he possesses an affectionate nature and a deep, devoted love for Anne Shirley. Unlike his well-behaved and dull twin sister Dora, Davy's vivid imagination and rebellious streak make him a lively presence at Green Gables.

## Traits

- Inquisitive
- Mischievous
- Impulsive
- Affectionate
- Outspoken

## Abilities

- Getting into creative predicament and pranks
- Asking endless difficult questions

## Goals

- To please Anne Shirley, whom he adores
- To satisfy his intense curiosity about the world

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora arrive at Green Gables in Anne of Avonlea after the death of their mother, Mary Keith, who was a third cousin to Marilla Cuthbert. Marilla takes them in temporarily, but after the death of their uncle Richard Keith, Marilla decides to adopt them permanently. From the moment of his arrival, Davy causes endless commotion with his irrepressible curiosity and tendency toward mischief, such as locking Dora in the woodshed or toad-infested adventures. Despite his misbehavior, he forms a deep emotional bond with Anne Shirley, who manages him with patience, love, and understanding. As the years progress through Anne of the Island and Anne's House of Dreams, Davy grows up under Marilla's care at Green Gables, attending the local school and maturing into a spirited young man while remaining deeply attached to Anne and Green Gables.

## Background by volume

- Son of Marilla Cuthbert's distant relative, Mary Keith
- Orphaned at a young age when his widowed mother passed away
- Taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley alongside his twin sister Dora

## Affiliations

- Green Gables Household — Adopted ward
- Avonlea School — Student
